items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: Steve March Torme, Mel Torme’s son.

ctx.x: So I was in this vocal group called Full Swing that was put together by Richard Perry, at that time a huge pop producer, and Joel Silver, a big movie producer. And they had this idea to have an updated big band with three vocalists in front of it. So they hired me and Charlotte Crossley, who was in “Jesus Christ Superstar” with me and also was a Harlette with Bette Midler, and Steve March Torme, Mel Torme’s son. So he was looking for songs for us to record. This is the first time I had an actual record deal so it…

hear Tommy Newsom’s big band. We heard this song called “La Bem” that Tommy had written, and then we had a meeting with Richard and he said, “I want to have lyrics to that song. I think we should hire a lyricist.” And for some reason I said, “I could do it.” I hadn’t really written lyrics all that much. I had made some attempts at writing kind of quasi-pop songs when I was in my late 20s. I was 32 at the time of this meeting. But I had grown up listening to Lambert, Hendricks & Ross and trying to sing along with…
